description: Two-arm pass-rate experiment: the immutable baseline harness vs an evolved candidate, over the ten frozen search tasks. Both arms run the identical protocol so the difference is attributable to the harness.
notes: arms.candidate is null in the committed config: the evolved harness is whatever the outer loop produced, and is supplied at run time with --candidate.
trials_per_task x 10 tasks x 2 arms = 200 task trials.
The model is not pinned here; it is read from META_HARNESS_INNER_MODEL (default claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) and recorded in environment.json.
